title: Many more recipes!
description: A datapack that adds many QoL and exotic recipes (e.g. horse armor, trident etc.)
body:
This is a datapack that adds 15 new crafting recipes including:

- Full chainmail armor set

- Totem of undying

- Glowstone dust

- Bottle of enchanting

- Green dye

- Bell

- Trident

- Horse armor (excluding netherite)

- Crying obsidian

- Red mushroom block (new with 1.2!)

- Brown mushroom block (new with 1.2!)



(for exact recipes, see the [gallery](https://modrinth.com/datapack/many-more-recipes/gallery))

 (may change in the future with newer versions) 



This pack is perfect if you want to _spice up your survival world_ a bit or if you just want to _build more automated farms_ using crafters


 ### NOTICE: ###

 this pack replaces the original leather horse armor recipe from:

A □  A\
A A A\
A □  A

to

□□  A\
A B A\
A A A

 key:
     A=leather, B=wool

   (the "□" is an empty square if it isn't rendering properly)
    
  so the old recipe **won't**     work anymore!



have fun with the pack!
